subject: feat(xpu): integrate KVarN hybrid caching with V2 DFlash2
requirement: Final feature commit in the old stack. Compact K4V2/K4V4 packed KV, native eager Xe2 fast path, independent target/recurrent/draft pools, transactional byte-budgeted CPU RAM prefixes with sink retention, mixed request admission, rollback and context ceilings. Current B70 is Qwen3.8-27B INT4 with two DFlash2 proposals, BF16 draft KV, four slots sharing capacity, 131072 context, 8 GiB RAM tier and 0.93 memory utilization. The old feature also supports combinations that depend on V1, including bundled Qwen MTP and K4V4. No later local commits supersede it.
observed: git show | git patch-id --stable matches the inventory. Old feature changes 102 paths (+23572/-325). Case-insensitive git grep for kvarn in the target vLLM source and in the target kernels csrc yields no matches. Inspected the alternative quant specs, planning, workers, connector and buffers at the exact tags.

Prior hardware evidence in ../../rebase-v033-20261108/gpu-qualification.json covers the assigned old tip plus kernel 05d4536: 17 K4V2, 18 GDN, 10 dtype and 7 RMSNorm native checks and 57 candidate service checks. Candidate v0.34 runtime tests, builds and benchmarks are outstanding.

outside_this_replay: Inkling2 is not a qualification proxy for this commit. Its D128/8-KV-head geometry and relative-bias/window/short-conv path need new model integration. The old qualified Xe2 DPAS layout checks D256 and the native writer requires four KV heads.
